title: Haul-Away Items and the Missed-Appointment Credit — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Missed-appointment extra for haul-away.** For a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the old items booked for haul-away are counted as the haul-away charge before benefits divided by the program's haul-away fee per item, which is 25.00 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery.

| Old items booked for haul-away | Extra percentage on the missed-appointment credit |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5 percent |
| one | 2 percent |
| no haul-away | nothing |

**Hypothetical bookings.** A haul-away charge of 75.00 before benefits is three old items and adds 5 percent; one of 25.00 is one old item and adds 2 percent, whatever amount was charged after benefits.
